_note: S4a UFC pilot (operator 2026-09-14: '30-second pilot first'). Prompts written by Claude from watching the footage (3 fps and 10 fps zoomed strips) and from ufc_pilot_windows.py's per-beat numbers. One body per generation, so every exchange has an A prompt and a B prompt on ONE clock: shot boundaries are footage times, and each strike's shot starts 0.3-0.5 s before the footage's peak.

source.title: UFC 260 Free Fight Brian Ortega vs Korean Zombie
source.file: round 1 only (video 0:00-7:30), 720p, no sound; operator approved in chat 2026-09-14; delete after the pilot
source.camera: UFC broadcast: cuts between a wide side-on camera, three-quarter cameras and a camera behind one fighter

fighters.A: Brian Ortega - dark maroon shorts, black gloves; the left man at each window's first frame; ORTHODOX in e1, SOUTHPAW from e2 on
fighters.B: Chan Sung Jung (the Korean Zombie) - red shorts, blue gloves; orthodox throughout

method.job: Higgsfield Blender add-on 'kimodo' job (ARDY), 20 fps, one body
method.why_h8: features/motion.py: ardy-core commits 2.0 s chunks and a shot shorter than that does not land; h8 commits 0.4 s chunks. Every beat here is under 2.5 s.

preroll.prompt: A fighter stands in an orthodox fighting stance with his hands up.
preroll.why: the model starts from a neutral standing pose; the first 20 frames are cut after generation

method.mirror: A southpaw is generated as an orthodox man with the same prompt (lead hand = 'left') and mirrored left-right after generation; prompts therefore always say left jab for the lead hand and right cross for the rear hand
method.no_clinch: Round 1 has no clinch on the cage inside a shot the tracker could follow (34 segments, 126.8 s with both men tracked); the pilot's five exchanges are the varied ones that exist.

exchanges.kind: a reset with feints around one right hand
exchanges.footage: Wide camera behind Korean Zombie. KZ darts forward low (76.9, +0.44 T, hips down 0.24 T); Ortega throws a straight right (77.44, rear hand) as KZ leans away; then 4 s of measuring - Ortega bouncing and feinting a half step in (79.9, +0.30 T) and out (80.4, -0.28 T), KZ pawing his left hand and inching forward, stepping in at 81.9 (+0.23 T) as Ortega steps back.
